name: Thai Glazed Tempeh Crumbles with Pickled Veggies, Avocado & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
473 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
rice vinegar
pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 English cucumber
2 red bell peppers
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
2 avocados
1 lime

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine; set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tempeh into the skillet and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Using a spatula, carefully flip and continue to cook, undisturbed, until golden brown, 5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 (227 g) packages tempeh

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the glaze.
instructions.secondary_message:
rice vinegar
pure maple syrup
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the tempeh is done, add glaze to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until glaze thickens, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide rice, pickled veggies, and glazed tempeh between bowls. Top with avocado and lime. Enjoy!
